power.answer: Royal Air Maroc's baggage page says lithium batteries go in carry-on baggage only, a passenger may carry a maximum of two power banks in the cabin, and power banks may not be recharged during the flight.

sections.h: 🔋 What Royal Air Maroc says about power banks
sections.p: From the "Restricted items" block of the Royal Air Maroc Baggage Information page, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Royal Air Maroc rule
rows: Maximum 2 power banks in the cabin per passenger
Rechargeable batteries in carry-on baggage only

list: Not on the page: a watt-hour limit, whether approval is possible above 100 Wh, and whether using the bank to charge a device is allowed. Contact Royal Air Maroc before you fly with a large bank.

faq: How many power banks can I take on Royal Air Maroc?
A maximum of two per passenger in the cabin.
Can I recharge my power bank on a Royal Air Maroc flight?
No. The airline's baggage page says passengers may not recharge power banks during the flight.
sources: Royal Air Maroc — Baggage Information (restricted items)
